lines.text: Did you know? Mov is Latin for move.
Motive: a reason that moves you.
Quick quiz! Which means forward plus move?

words.ex: The campaign aims to promote healthy eating.
Profit is the main motive for most businesses.
The boat has a small electric motor.

publish.title: Mov root: promote, motive and motor
publish.value: Mov comes from Latin "movere" (to move). Words: promote, motive and motor. promote = pro + mote.
